name: Barrister
body:
Cost +1 bonus; Aura faint transmutation; CL 4th; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

An legendary inquisitor can store one use of an instantaneous 1st-level office ability inside a barrister weapon. The legendary inquisitor loses one daily use of her 1st-level office ability as long as the barrister weapon stores it. When hitting a creature with a barrister weapon, the character can choose to discharge the stored office ability (either on the opponent or herself ) as a free action, at a level equal to her legendary inquisitor level +4. The stored ability otherwise expires and is lost the next time the inquisitor regains spells.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; splendor of office
